pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding positions within 15 minutes or $2.00 of a previous losing entry; absolute cap of 1 concurrent trade per directional node unless unrealized profit exceeds +$10.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe liquidity sweep and volume exhaustion confirmation before order authorization; completely block entries during Tier-1 macro news release windows.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop-lock or partial harvest once floating profit reaches +$12.00 to prevent erosion back to breakeven or minor gains.
